items.synopsis: MacSec session will not be up on the new fallback key during the primary key transition
items.description: On all Junos and Evolved platforms, during the primary key transition on the MacSec session, when a new fallback key is updated on the MacSec peers the session will not come up due to the primary key remaining live on the same interface. When this happens, there will be a traffic drop on the MacSec interface. This is a rare issue and only occur when certain sequence of steps will be performed.

items.synopsis: The rpd crash will be observed during the MPLS label block allocation
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms in the Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) scenario, the rpd crash will happen in rare conditions during MPLS label block allocation.

items.synopsis: The rpd crash would be observed in a RSVP scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with RSVP enabled, the rpd (routing protocol daemon) crash will be observed while updating the RSVP path information with a new metric. When this happens, the core files are generated and some traffic loss will be seen.

items.category: EVO L3 routing for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: EVO:: JDI_FT_REGRESSIONS [tunnel] [grtag] : qfx5130-32cd :: Partial traffic loss is seen while verifying bi-directinal traffic over GRE

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: The traffic loop would be observed when ESI is configured on IFD
items.description: On PTX Junos Evolved platforms when Ethernet Segment Identifier (ESI) for multihomed Ethernet Virtual Private Network-Multiprotocol Label Switching (EVPN-MPLS) scenario is configured on the physical interface (IFD), and multiple logical interfaces (IFLs) within the same IFD are associated with Bridge Domains/VLANs within the same MAC-VRF routing instance for service-type VLAN-Aware, then the traffic loop will be observed between Multihomed Customer Edge and Provider Edge devices for the Broadcast, Unknown unicast, and Multicast (BUM) traffic.
